description: Create a prefilled seatac.co reservation link for the customer to open. They review the trip, enter contact details, and pay on seatac.co. Nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

dropoff.description: Drop-off location. Street address, hotel, or place in the Seattle area, e.g. "Seattle-Tacoma International Airport", "Pier 91", "Hyatt Regency Bellevue", or "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Optional for hourly charters.

flight_number.description: Optional flight number for Seatac pickups or drop-offs, e.g. AS 123.

hours.description: Set only for an hourly charter: the number of hours (1-24).

pickup.description: Pickup location. Street address, hotel, or place in the Seattle area, e.g. "Seattle-Tacoma International Airport", "Pier 91", "Hyatt Regency Bellevue", or "1301 5th Ave, Seattle".

pickup_datetime.description: Pickup date and time, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is read as Seattle local time (America/Los_Angeles), e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30. Optional.

vehicle_slug.description: Optional vehicle_slug from quote_ride or get_service_info to preselect.

name: start_booking
title: Start a seatac.co booking
